Who we are

About the Ministry

The public-facing home for the ministry's mandate, priorities, initiatives and work within Youth Parliament Ghana. The leadership and directorate details in this prototype are based on the appointment announcements and organizational structure supplied for Youth Parliament Ghana. Confirm final content and branding before public launch.

◎

Our Mission

Promote responsible technology use, digital literacy, communication, and innovation among young people.

◇

Our Vision

A connected and innovative youth community equipped to participate confidently in the digital world.

↗

Our Priorities

Digital inclusion, skills development, creative problem-solving, and transparent public communication.

Our structure

Departments & Areas of Work

Expanded portfolio areas informed by the structure and public-facing responsibilities described on Ghana's national ministry website. These are adapted suggestions for Youth Parliament Ghana, not a claim that the two institutions share the same formal structure.

▦

General Administration

Official correspondence, records management, meeting minutes, scheduling, protocol, logistics, document control, and administrative coordination.

Department information →

Digital Technology

Digital literacy, ICT skills, responsible technology adoption, practical workshops, and digital transformation awareness.

Innovation & Startups

Youth innovation challenges, prototype development, entrepreneurship awareness, idea showcases, and links to innovation communities.

Explore initiatives →
▤

Communications & Public Relations

Media releases, public notices, website updates, social media, stakeholder communications, and approved ministry messaging.
